facts.text: The comparison covers laps 40–50, using 10 valid matched laps and excluding 1 lap.
Lewis Hamilton averaged 89.677 seconds per included lap; Lando Norris averaged 89.980 seconds.
Lewis Hamilton was quicker by 0.303 seconds per lap on average in this matched sample.
The sum of included lap-time differences (first driver minus second) is -3.031 seconds. This is not the race gap.

caveat: These are observed lap-time differences, not proof of why they happened. Tyres, traffic, weather and strategy can confound the comparison. Summed matched-lap deltas are not the on-track race gap.
method: Matched lap numbers; exclude lap 1, missing/invalid/duplicate laps, pit entry and next lap, flagged out-laps, and laps overlapping a caution message. Caution intervals are not fully reconstructed; this is not a clean-air pace estimate.
